caveats.text: MIDASCNNModel fuses an EfficientNet-B0 image encoder with a 16-dim MetadataEncoder. These figures were measured with the real patient metadata vector present. Production inference supplies torch.zeros(1, 16) (backend/app/services/cnn_model_service.py). These figures therefore do not describe the deployed system, whose accuracy is unknown and expected to be lower.
Validation split, not a held-out test set. Model selection ran on this same split (early stopping on balanced_accuracy), so the figures are optimistically biased.
No dataset is present in the repo and the split definition is not recoverable, so these numbers cannot be re-derived from source.

notMeasured: per-class precision / recall / F1 (the checkpoint records only aggregate scalars per epoch)
accuracy of the deployed zero-metadata pipeline
